description: Each imported bank statement against the books: the statement's period, its opening and closing balance as printed, the book balance on the statement's end date, the difference and whether they agree. Use this to answer 'does the bank agree?', 'what was the closing balance in March?', or before quoting any reconciliation difference. Optional bank_account_id.

company.description: Which company to read, by name or id, when the account has more than one (see list_companies). Leave it out to use the only company, or the default.
